name: Wherobots Spatial AI Assistant
description: Discover private and public geospatial datasets, inspect schemas, generate spatial SQL, run queries, and build spatial data apps directly in Claude. Create shareable physical-world insights and interactive analyses in minutes using natural language, powered by Wherobots’ secure, distributed spatial compute engine for planetary-scale vector (geometry, geography) and raster (overhead and satellite imagery) data. Simplify spatial workflows with an AI agent that helps you get past the technical barrier to understanding the physical world.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Wherobots Spatial AI Assistant to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Wherobots Spatial AI Assistant to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://api.cloud.wherobots.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Wherobots Spatial AI Assistant MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Wherobots Spatial AI Assistant provides these MCP tools: describe_table_tool, execute_query_tool, generate_spatial_query_tool, list_catalogs_tool, list_databases_tool, list_tables_tool, and search_documentation_tool.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Wherobots Spatial AI Assistant?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Wherobots Spatial AI Assistant in data-analytics on the Manufact MCP catalog include Epicure, Newsflash, Point Topic, Pricing Optimizer AI, and StatCite.

_published_faq.name: Does Wherobots Spatial AI Assistant MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Wherobots Spatial AI Assistant requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.

_published_faq.name: Who develops Wherobots Spatial AI Assistant?

acceptedAnswer.text: Wherobots Spatial AI Assistant is developed by Wherobots. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
